title: Spider-Man's Biggest Problem? No One Remembers Him!
summary: Imagine waking up one day and your best friend, your crush, even your own family—nobody remembers you. That's Peter Parker's life now. In the new trailer for "Spider-Man: Brand New Day," we see Peter struggling. He's a regular guy in New York trying to pay rent, but he also has spider powers. The problem? A spell made the whole world forget he's Spider-Man. Even the Avengers don't know him! Now things are getting weirder. Peter's body is changing in strange ways—maybe a mutation (a big change in his body). He's fighting a villain called Scorpion, a bunch of ninjas, and even the Hulk! But the scariest part is a mysterious bad guy that only Peter can sense. The trailer shows lots of old Spider-Man movie clips, which some fans think is a little desperate. But the last movie, "No Way Home," had a super emotional ending where Peter said goodbye to MJ and Ned. It made people cry! If this new movie can make us care about the characters like that, it could be amazing. "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" comes out on July 31, 2026. Will you be there to see if Peter can make people remember him?
why_it_matters: Everyone feels forgotten sometimes, and Peter's struggle reminds us that true friends remember who we really are.

background_read: Spider-Man is a popular superhero from Marvel comics and movies. In the story, a radioactive spider bit Peter Parker and gave him amazing powers like climbing walls and super strength.
The last Spider-Man movie, 'No Way Home,' brought back older Spider-Man actors from past films, which made many fans very happy.
Fans are excited because this new movie might continue that emotional story.
Article_Structure: WHO: Peter Parker, a regular guy with spider powers.
WHAT: No one remembers he is Spider-Man, and his body is changing strangely.
WHY: The story shows him fighting villains and trying to make people remember him, exploring if he can reclaim his life.

perspectives.description: They can't wait to see Spider-Man fight new enemies and find out if he can fix the spell.
